description: Decap CMS: open-source, Git-based CMS for static site generators (formerly Netlify CMS)
rules: Install with the decap-cms script tag (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/decap-cms@^3.0.0/dist/decap-cms.js), or with npm i decap-cms-app react react-dom when using a bundler.
decap-cms-app needs React 19 from npm. React 19 has no UMD builds, so do not load React or decap-cms-app from a CDN; the decap-cms bundle already includes React.
Configure the CMS in admin/config.yml, next to admin/index.html; editors open it at /admin/.
The git-gateway backend is deprecated by its provider; use the github, gitlab, gitea or bitbucket backend with an OAuth client, or Decap Turbo.
Docs: https://decapcms.org/docs/ and, as one file for agents, https://decapcms.org/llms-full.txt
